data.name: Frost Muscle
data.detailed_description:
What Happened?

The world's efforts to reverse global warming were successful. Too successful. So much that the lack of greenhouse gases caused runaway cooling. While everyone was celebrating, the weather was already out of their hands. Now everything is buried under thick ice and snow, and most resources are out of reach. A few camps of civilization remain on the dwindling resources.

What now?

You are part of a small camp of surviving humans who are using up the last of the energy to stay warm. An old power station with unused nuclear fuel is rumored to exist. You are supposed to find it and check it out if it could be used as a power resource. All you have is your old but reliable muscle car with its V8 engine to keep you warm and half buried gas stations on the way. But you have to be quick cause everything is getting buried under the snow or falling apart.

Gameplay

Drive, skid, and drift on the snow-covered paths. Reach gas stations before they are buried and cross bridges before they crumble. You are looking for a power station by a lighthouse, so go towards the light.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 3xxx
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (recent generation)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 or better 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur (11.6.8)
  • Processor: Any M1 or Intel Macs 2016 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 or for Intel Macs: Mac mini 2018, MacBook Air 2017, MacBook Pro 13” 2016. HD Graphics 6000 or UHD 630 is the minimum requirement for 720p at low settings. Higher resolutions and/or better visual quality on Intel-Macs require a Mac with dedicated GPU.
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Monterey
  • Processor: M1Pro
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any recent Mac with dedicated GPU with 4GB video RAM or more, i.e. iMac 2015 M395X, iMac 2019 with Vega48 or similar.
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
